# Planted bugs of orgpki (scripts/go-mutants.sh org/orgpki/testdata/mutants.txt, make test-go-mutants):
# each line "<mutant> | <file> | <exact line text> | <replacement> | <test>". Lines of one
# mutant are applied together; the test must then fail. Models:
# spec/proverif/enrol.pv and spec/enrol/Enrol.tla; orgpki_test.go names the
# property each test enforces. Not here: the verifier's (no-chain-check,
# no-name-check, no-expiry-check, no-crl-check, no-group-check,
# leaf-group-outside-issuer, fail-open, accept-older-crl, rotate-by-primary,
# replayed-rotation: the relay client's orgid, which the issuer's rotation
# check uses too, plants them in its own testdata/mutants.txt), and the
# session-level mutants no-expiry-timer and no-cut-on-update (the
# verifier's callers, orgmachine).
